reconciliation.finding: the 64 vs 52 conflict: DP1-EP5 needs 64 dedicated dies (4 primary + 60 expert replicas); its "12 baseline draft dies" were TP4 x 3 blocks of the old timing model, and the rack's 12 head dies still carry the WHOLE drafter as head content (head model basis: 15,131 DSpark pairs = 7.93 GB over 12 dies, 1,261 a die).  So the rack (52) double-counts nothing but under-counts the dedicated draft dies by 12, and the head dies carry 15,131 pairs that DP1-EP5 never reads.
